programmes.d: A Union major (Charlton Heston) chases Indians to Mexico with a condemned Confederate captain (Richard Harris) and a cavalry of prisoners.
Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.
A rancher (Glenn Ford) fights a land-grabbing cattle baron (Edward G. Robinson) whose wife (Barbara Stanwyck) and brother are having an affair.
A cynical former sheriff turned bounty hunter, helps a young, recently appointed acting sheriff with his advice, his experience and his gun.
A land baron's (Robert Duvall) gunman (Clint Eastwood) joins a rebel (John Saxon) fighting for Spanish land grants in 1900 New Mexico.
A cunning Profane Sister Sara recruits a drifter to help Mexican rebels launch a surprise attack on a French fort.
A gun-fighting stranger comes to the small settlement of Lago and is hired to bring the townsfolk together in an attempt to hold off three outlaws who are on their way.
When a bounty hunter and a band of unlikely heroes pursue a brutal killer, they find themselves in a deadly no-man's-land known as the Thicket.

Cowboy Johnny Black vows to gun down Brett Clayton, the man responsible for the death of his father. He soon becomes a wanted outlaw while posing as a preacher in a small mining town that's been taken over by a notorious land baron.
Cisco proves that the man being held in jail on a murder charge is not the actual murderer.
A respectable businessman traps an elderly man into a rustling ring scheme that Pancho and Cisco later discover.
A gunfighter (Randolph Scott) loses his beloved in a robbery and hunts the man (George Macready) to blame, who is living off the loot.
When Larry Delong, a shotgun guard on a stagecoach, finds his reputation sullied by a gang of outlaws, he has his work cut out convincing the town that he is honest.
